All three functions are now implemented:

1. **formatBytes(n)** in src/util.js — converts byte counts to human-readable format (B/KB/MB/GB) with one decimal place
2. **slugify(title)** in src/text.js — converts titles to URL slugs (lowercase, trim, spaces → dashes, removes non-alphanumeric/dash characters)
3. **fetchUsers(baseUrl)** in src/api.js — async function that fetches users from `${baseUrl}/api/users`, logs the count, and returns the array

All three are exported from their modules.
